# scripts/Visual/Wardrobe.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Visual/Wardrobe.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Assembles Blender wardrobe pieces on the game skeleton and rolls deterministic per-person appearance.
Quaternius-derived bodies are built by tools/wardrobe. Extra cloth bones are added before skin rebind.
Rebind converts source rest frames to target rest frames; all instances sharing textures reuse materials.
apply_look() writes per-mesh shader parameters, preserving shared material ownership.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.

### roll

```gdscript
static func roll(options: Dictionary, skin_tones: Dictionary, seed: int) -> Dictionary
```

[Source:134](../../../../../scripts/Visual/Wardrobe.gd#L134)

What this man wears and looks like, drawn from a kind's `options` (its
JSON's): {face, tone, hair, beard, headgear, dye, fade, grime, height,
skin, hair_colour}. Eleven draws, always all eleven and in this order, so
an option added later never changes the rest of anyone's looks: the nine
of the spec (§7.5), then (batch 1) which dye colour of `dye.colours`, and
which of `hair_colours` (his face's own, if it has any: the old face's greys).
Which hair a helmet hides is the dresser's
business (Humanoid.dress), not the roll's.

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `Dictionary` | required |
| `skin_tones` | `Dictionary` | required |
| `seed` | `int` | required |

Return type: `Dictionary`.

### skinned

```gdscript
static func skinned(path: String, target: Skeleton3D, body: String) -> Array
```

[Source:366](../../../../../scripts/Visual/Wardrobe.gd#L366)

The mesh of the part at `path` (a GLB) and its skin, re-bound to
`target`, after giving `target` the bones it lacks (cloth). Read once for
each body kind; every man of that body shares the mesh and the skin.
Nothing for a file with no skinned mesh (remembered: one error, not one
a man).

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `String` | required |
| `target` | `Skeleton3D` | required |
| `body` | `String` | required |

Return type: `Array`.
